title: The Undercover Man
description: Two Treasury agents (Glenn Ford, James Whitmore) set out to nail a mobster for tax evasion.

title: Jason and the Argonauts
description: The Greek hero (Todd Armstrong) sails through Harpies and clashing rocks to the Golden Fleece, guarded by the Hydra.

title: Sahara
description: An Army sergeant (Humphrey Bogart), his tank crew (Bruce Bennett, Dan Duryea) and stragglers hold off a Nazi battalion at a waterhole.

title: The Collector
description: A British butterfly collector kidnaps an art student, Miranda Grey, and keeps her in his farmhouse cellar.

title: Dead Reckoning
description: A World War II hero (Humphrey Bogart) solves his buddy's murder, starting with a singer (Lizabeth Scott) and a nightclub owner (Morris Carnovsky).

title: Miss Sadie Thompson
description: A shady woman (Rita Hayworth) from San Francisco joins Marines and a moral reformer (Jose Ferrer) in the postwar Pacific.

title: You Belong to Me
description: A doctor's (Barbara Stanwyck) idle millionaire husband (Henry Fonda) becomes unbearably jealous of her patients.

title: Cactus Flower
description: A dentist (Walter Matthau) has his prim assistant (Ingrid Bergman) pose as his wife to discourage his kooky girlfriend (Goldie Hawn).

title: Tell It to the Judge
description: A lawyer (Robert Cummings) chases his lawyer ex-wife (Rosalind Russell) from Florida to the Adirondacks, where she poses as a playboy's (Gig Young) wife.

title: Forbidden
description: The mistress (Barbara Stanwyck) of a lawyer (Adolphe Menjou) running for governor marries an editor (Ralph Bellamy), who finds she has a baby.

title: The Black Knight
description: A common swordsmith (Alan Ladd) freelances for King Arthur to prove himself worthy of an earl's daughter (Patricia Medina).

title: American Madness
description: An idealistic bank officer is taken to task by the board of directors when they learn of his unorthodox loan policies.

title: The Chance of a Lifetime
description: Sleuth Boston Blackie (Chester Morris) helps a wartime convict (Erik Rolf) framed for murder while out on parole.

title: Gidget
description: A California girl called Gidget (Sandra Dee) spends summer with surf bums called Moondoggie (James Darren) and Kahuna (Cliff Robertson).

title: The Happy Time
description: A violinist (Charles Boyer) and his brother (Louis Jourdan) guide one's son through his crush on the family maid in the 1920s Ottawa.

title: Pal Joey
description: A singer (Frank Sinatra) flirts with a chorus girl (Kim Novak) from Albuquerque after a San Francisco socialite (Rita Hayworth) buys him a nightclub.

title: Autumn Leaves
description: A New England spinster (Joan Crawford) marries a younger man (Cliff Robertson) who has mental problems and another wife (Vera Miles).

title: Gidget Grows Up
description: Gidget goes to New York, becomes a U.N. guide and meets an older man.

title: The Harder They Fall
description: A fight promoter (Rod Steiger) hires a hard-luck sportswriter (Humphrey Bogart) to hype a simple Argentine boxer for the mob.

title: A Man for All Seasons
description: Sir Thomas More (Paul Scofield) opposes Henry VIII's (Robert Shaw) appointing himself head of the Church of England.

title: Don't Raise the Bridge, Lower the River
description: A dreamer (Jerry Lewis) and a British con man (Terry-Thomas) plot to steal an oil-drill invention and sell it to the Arabs.

title: The Awful Truth
description: Spouses (Irene Dunne, Cary Grant) try to spoil each other's chances for romance before their divorce becomes final in 90 days.

title: Only Angels Have Wings
description: A sassy chorus girl (Jean Arthur) falls in love with a seat-of-the-pants pilot (Cary Grant) in South America.

title: Love Has Many Faces
description: A woman (Lana Turner) lives in Acapulco with moochers and a husband (Cliff Robertson) who married her for her money.

title: Fail-Safe
description: The president (Henry Fonda) cannot stop a Strategic Air Command plane accidentally cued to bomb Moscow.

title: The Mouse That Roared
description: The field marshal, prime minister and grand duchess (Peter Sellers) of Fenwick declare war on the United States.

title: Holiday
description: A tomboy New York socialite (Katharine Hepburn) flirts with her stuffy sister's (Doris Nolan) down-to-earth fiancé (Cary Grant).

title: The Magic Carpet
description: An ousted prince harnesses the power of a mystical floor covering to drive a villainous caliph from the throne.

title: It Had to Be You
description: A marriage-shy sculptor (Ginger Rogers) meets the Indian boy of her childhood dreams, now a firefighter (Cornel Wilde).

title: Divorce American Style
description: A couple (Dick Van Dyke, Debbie Reynolds) break up after 15 years of marriage, then get back together as the easy way out.

title: Funny Girl
description: Ziegfeld Follies star Fanny Brice (Barbra Streisand) falls for gambler Nicky Arnstein (Omar Sharif).

title: How to Save a Marriage and Ruin Your Life
description: A bachelor (Dean Martin) tries to save his buddy's (Eli Wallach) marriage by stealing his mistress, who is not who he thinks.

title: The Fuller Brush Girl
description: A door-to-door saleswoman (Lucille Ball) and her boyfriend (Eddie Albert) flee from mobsters and the police after a murder mix-up.

title: What a Woman!
description: An author (Willard Parker) and a literary agent (Rosalind Russell) become involved after selling film rights to his racy book.

title: The Cockleshell Heroes
description: A British major (Jose Ferrer) and captain (Trevor Howard) lead marines in canoes on a mission to mine Nazi ships in Bordeaux.

title: Hellcats of the Navy
description: A submarine commander (Ronald Reagan) enters the Sea of Japan with a frogman who had flirted with his girlfriend (Nancy Davis).

title: The Last Hurrah
description: An aging New England politician struggles to maintain his position as mayor in a hard-fought and questionable campaign.

title: The Trouble With Angels
description: A headstrong girl (Hayley Mills) and her best friend (June Harding) bedevil the mother superior (Rosalind Russell) of a convent school.

title: 711 Ocean Drive
description: A telephone repairman (Edmond O'Brien) becomes the boss of a gambling syndicate he has ingeniously wired for profit.

title: Pushover
description: A gangster's girlfriend (Kim Novak) seduces a police detective (Fred MacMurray) who has her under surveillance.

title: A Woman of Distinction
description: Scandalous rumors link the dean (Rosalind Russell) of a women's college with a professor of astronomy (Ray Milland) from England.

title: Let's Do It Again
description: A composer's (Ray Milland) singing-and-dancing wife (Jane Wyman) tries to make him jealous, but it backfires into a divorce.
